summary: A promo code shared on X by Mistral AI itself (@MistralAI), not verified by freetokens. The post, dated 2026-11-17, says: “we’re making Vibe free in Europe for the first 3 months.” and “Use code LECHONK via link in 🧵. Limited time, first-come, first-served.” A reply by @MistralAI in the same thread says: “Limited offer for developers in Europe: Start with Vibe Pro free for three months with the code LECHONK via link: https://bit.ly/VibeProLimitedOffer. Terms apply.” The post gives no end date. Ended 2026-11-23: Mistral posted that this promo “ran out of capacity in less than an hour” and replaced it with code MISTRALVIBE.
claim_steps: Ended 2026-11-23: Mistral posted “We ran out of capacity in less than an hour.” (https://x.com/MistralAI/status/2124905610386780451). Its new code is MISTRALVIBE.
Open the link from Mistral’s thread: https://bit.ly/VibeProLimitedOffer
Use the code LECHONK. The thread says: “Start with Vibe Pro free for three months with the code LECHONK via link”.
On who can use it, the thread says: “Limited offer for developers in Europe”.
On limits, the post says: “Limited time, first-come, first-served.” The thread adds: “Terms apply.” No end date is given.

social_proof.author: Mistral AI
social_proof.text: To celebrate Mistral Vibe + Le Chonk becoming the world’s best open model-harness duo, we’re making Vibe free in Europe for the first 3 months. (Yes, it’s actually better than GLM / DeepSeek at coding). Use code LECHONK via link in 🧵. Limited time, first-come, first-served.
